entities.name: Shielded Sea
entities.description: Sea south of the Terisian Isles, connecting to the Sea of Laments, South Sea and Shattered Sea.

entities.name: Shattered Sea
entities.description: Sea formed when the ocean reclaimed Fyndhorn.

entities.name: Kelsinko
entities.description: City on the shores of the Fyndhorn forest risen from the sea floor.

entities.name: Fyndhorn
entities.description: Forest risen from the Shielded Sea floor, later largely reclaimed by the ocean.

events.summary: Fyndhorn is largely reclaimed by the ocean, forming the Shattered Sea.
events.quote: This was later largely reclaimed by the ocean, forming the Shattered Sea
